title: Peninsulares y criollos
goal: Read how criollos briefly bought their way into power under the Habsburgs, and how the Bourbon reforms deliberately closed that door, turning a slow grievance into an acute one.

items: Explain how some criollos accessed important posts under the Habsburgs.
Explain what changed with the Bourbon reforms.
Describe how many criollos felt about that change.
Explain why this shift felt different from centuries of slower exclusion.
Use passive voice to narrate a policy reversal over time.
